integrity: Proof includes a uniform combinatorial cell classification and equivariant simplicial collapse. Standalone exhaustive tests at r=2,3,4 are supplementary, not a substitute for the argument.
scientific_limitations: Uniform claim requires r>=2 and ground cardinality 2r+1. Prior literature already implies the nonequivariant wedge-of-circles conclusion. New claim concerns the equivariant incidence-graph reduction, integral module, and quotient types. No theorem for other parameters or Borel equivariant cohomology; no independent audit; residual unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Equivariant incidence-graph model for near-perfect Kneser Hom complexes
